title: C19 Two-sources-of-truth + cross-tab sync (FLAGSHIP)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The challenge deliberately creates a disagreement between the TanStack client cache and the RSC / 'use cache' server cache (e.g. a mutation revalidates the server cache while the client cache still holds the old value) and makes the divergence visible.

A documented reconciliation strategy resolves the divergence (e.g. invalidate the TanStack query on server revalidation / refetch-on-focus) so both sources converge to the same value, with the chosen strategy justified in NOTES.md.
Cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel (or storage events) propagates a mutation in one tab to a second open tab so both tabs converge without a manual reload.
cache-flow.md contains the committed cache-flow diagram showing both caches, where they diverge, and where reconciliation/sync occurs.

The c19 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers + the cache-flow diagram), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; the QueryProvider is local to this challenge and neither lib/data nor the root layout is edited.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
